name: v4.0.0-rc.1
body:
### Breaking since rc.0
- `@crawlee/jsdom` and `@crawlee/linkedom` moved out of the monorepo (#4119)
- Crawler-only code moved from `@crawlee/core` to `@crawlee/basic`, more internals made private (#4117, #4036, #4060)
- Input handling moved to the Apify SDK, requires `apify` >= 4.0.0-beta.40 (#4155)
- The request queue is no longer emptied between `run()` calls (#4056)
- Statistics renames, `IRequestManager` / `IBrowserPool` contract updates (#4109, #4061, #4161)

### New
- `DomCrawler` with a pluggable DOM parser (#4104)
- OpenTelemetry instrumentation via `@crawlee/otel` (#3361)
- `skipRequest` and `afterCommit` context helpers (#4158, #4110), `initialConcurrency` option (#4067), `extractMicrodata` helper (#3233)

### Fixes
HTTP redirect handling for credentials, cookies and request bodies (#4137, #4154, #4136), Cloudflare challenge detection (#4170), a robots.txt 404 now means allow-all (#4171), and more.

Upgrading guide: https://crawlee.dev/js/docs/next/upgrading/upgrading-to-v4

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/apify/crawlee/compare/v4.0.0-rc.0...v4.0.0-rc.1
